In a passive, one object is promoted to subject, leaving at most ONE retained object; here subject 'you' plus TWO post-verbal NPs ('your students', 'an opening routine') would require three argument slots, which 'teach' cannot license. Semantically the addressee-teacher is the agent, so passive also inverts the logic. Correct form: active 'have taught your students an opening routine' (parallel with 'are prepared ... and have taught'). Ungrammatical.
